title: Conditionals, Wishes and the Unreal Past (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj zdania (1.1.-1.8.). Wykorzystujac wyrazy podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij kazde zdanie z luka tak, aby precyzyjnie oddac sens zdania wyjsciowego. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna wpisywanych fragmentow zdan. Uwaga: nie zmieniaj formy podanych wyrazow. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac maksymalnie piec wyrazow, wliczajac w to wyraz juz podany. Formy skrocone (np. needn't, they're) sa liczone jako dwa wyrazy.

items.original: It is a pity that I cannot drive.
The accident happened because of the fog, so we were late.
items.transformed: If it _________ the fog, we would not have been late.

items.original: He did not revise, so he failed the test.
items.transformed: If he _________, he would have passed the test.

items.original: I regret that I told him the truth.
She behaves as though the house belongs to her.
items.transformed: She behaves as if _________ the house.

items.original: It is time for you to go to bed.
Without your help, I would not have finished.
items.transformed: If you _________ me, I would not have finished.

items.original: I would like you to be more careful.
